CP0.name: Current feature evidence
CP0.minimumDecision: Retain only public feature claims backed by a fresh normal-input journey on the immutable 5.0 candidate.

CP1.name: Deterministic fixed world
CP1.minimumDecision: Retain the production fixed-location Earth authority with deterministic Shortbread transport, optional exact Overpass gap-fill, and explicit forced-outage evidence at the representative release locations.

CP2.name: Worldwide transport and vehicle contact
CP2.minimumDecision: Retain the compiled road/bridge/tunnel authority, reviewed bridge spans over mapped water, mapped share-link road identity, and measured four-wheel vehicle contact without claiming geometry beyond published provider data.

CP3.name: Buildings, facades, entrances, and interiors
CP3.minimumDecision: Ship mapped indoor geometry on each available source level and generated fallback floors with working stairs, elevator, collision, keyboard/touch entry, exit recovery, and reload teardown. Explicit mapped connector semantics and moderated indoor overlay publication remain staged beyond the minimum 5.0 and are not public claims.

CP4.name: Player, Backpack, Journal, progression, and controls
CP4.minimumDecision: Ship one versioned local/account reconciliation contract for Backpack rewards, Journal, Field Guide, and progression; retain the tested Standard/Southpaw touch profiles with reset and reload recovery. Full per-action remapping, gamepad profiles, and editor/AR-specific bindings remain staged and are not minimum-5.0 claims.

CP5.name: Urban Sandbox
CP5.minimumDecision: Ship the retained equipment, vehicle, responder, custody, mapped-facility, and room-authority journeys proven by normal input. Universal full-body embodiment and broader sandbox simulation remain staged and are not minimum-5.0 claims.

CP6.name: Missions, engagement, crafting, and economy
CP6.minimumDecision: The minimum 5.0 retains Field Today, daily/weekly Expeditions, seasonal surveys, progression, and existing games. Crafting, currency, and a reward-grade unified economy are excluded and must not be publicly claimed.

CP7.name: Live GPS Field Expeditions and regional ecology
CP7.minimumDecision: Ship the reviewed Baltimore 60-taxon regional slice and honest virtual field leads; make no worldwide ecology or live-animal-presence claim.

CP8.name: Water, Ocean, fishing, and environmental evidence
CP8.minimumDecision: Ship one honest shore/boat virtual fishing authority; connect underwater schools before describing water fish as unified.

CP9.name: Multiplayer and creator publishing
CP9.minimumDecision: Retain authenticated rooms, one public World Editor containing reviewed semantic overlays and persistent local/room Blocks, and explicitly device-local activity creation. Do not expose Blocks as a competing top-level editor or claim public activity publishing.

CP10.name: Performance, memory, and data use
CP10.minimumDecision: Enforce numeric budgets on the physical Apple M1/8 GB desktop and a clearly labeled 390x844 Chrome touch-regression tier; do not claim physical-phone battery, thermal, or sustained FPS evidence until a phone is measured.

CP11.name: UI, accessibility, presentation, and release identity
CP11.minimumDecision: Require keyboard and 390x844 touch completion of every retained primary flow, honest public claims, inspected runtime captures, and one immutable 5.0 identity.
openItems: Build the clean 5.0 staging version, run the current release boundary, inspect its final desktop/mobile frames, and obtain owner approval before production.
